text: Build job 3, part 2, of the records-history plan (docs/design/records-history.md section 8.1, decision D111): a reconcile step that finds main's first-parent commits since the last landing record that have no landing record, matches each to a landing-intent record by head tree and expected base, and writes the missing landing record; with no matching intent it asks the host which pull request merged, and if the host cannot answer it reports the commit as unattributed and writes nothing. Run it at the start of athena land and athena status. Tests: a crash between the host's merge and the landing record is repaired from the intent alone; a host that is unavailable gives 'unattributed' and no record; a commit with no intent and no pull request is reported, never guessed.
